draft_windows.Josh Jacobs: AVOID at old Round 3-4 price; only take after major fall into Round 7+ territory and only if roster can absorb zeroes
draft_windows.MarShawn Lloyd: ATTACK in Rounds 6-7 if Jacobs remains exempt; do not assume uncontested bell-cow because Kaleb Johnson/Chris Brooks remain
draft_windows.Ashton Jeanty: TAKE only after injury discount; active-roster status lowers worst-case risk but does not prove Week 1 full workload
TAKE in Rounds 9-11 as contingent upside; move earlier only if Jeanty gets a negative Week 1 update
draft_windows.Kenneth Walker III: DO NOT panic-sell; acceptable late Round 2/early Round 3 if no new setback
draft_windows.Garrett Wilson: ATTACK at market price; do not force a full round ahead of board unless WR tier is about to cliff
draft_windows.Saquon Barkley: TAKE in mid/late Round 2; do not chase into early Round 1
draft_windows.Chris Olave: ATTACK in the late Round 2/early Round 3 cluster
draft_windows.Jordyn Tyson: IR stash only in deep benches; otherwise leave for waivers

strategy.rb_runs: Do not chase automatically. Chase only when the run is consuming the final backs in a board tier; otherwise harvest WR/TE value created by the room.
strategy.qb: Josh Allen is the only QB worth considering at a true Round-3 discount; otherwise prefer the Maye/Daniels or Herbert/Lawrence value pockets and exploit late Purdy-type value.
strategy.te: Pay only at a real tier edge. Do not force TE because of a room run if comparable target volume exists later.
strategy.injury_flags: Treat platform Q/O/PUP/IR icons as prompts for source verification, not automatic downgrades. Commissioner Exempt and IR/PUP designations are material because they directly constrain availability.
